item.text:
You have two offers on your deal desk:

- **ByteBuddy — Open:** AI homework helper app, one Short, offered ₹7,000, due October 28, with paid ads usage up to 90 days. Your notes say you expressed interest and countered at ₹11,000 with organic use only; the brand hasn’t replied. The deal is still marked **Open**.
- **CodeKaro — In talks:** Python learning app, one Instagram Reel, ₹10,000, organic use only, due October 25. The brand accepted the fee and usage by DM, but still wants 30 days of exclusivity. Nothing is marked agreed yet.

There are also planned video tasks for both deals.
